scripts.docker:deps: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.docker:stop:app: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml stop api worker web
scripts.docker:db:wipe:run: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml run --rm api python scripts/wipe_database.py
scripts.docker:rebuild:web: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml build web && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d web
scripts.docker:rebuild:api: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml build api worker && docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml up -d api worker
scripts.docker:restart: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml restart api worker web
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml logs -f --tail=200 api web worker
scripts.docker:reseed: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api python scripts/seed.py --full
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api python scripts/seed.py
scripts.docker:db:wipe: docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml exec -T api python scripts/wipe_database.py
